_comment: Source of truth for this service's entire RabbitMQ topology (event-contract.md). Nothing here is hardcoded in C# - RabbitMqTopologyProvisioner scans this file and declares every exchange/queue/binding/DLQ/retry-tier at startup. Category consumes zero events (event-contract.md, 'Consumed Events: None'), so queues/deadLetterQueues are empty here - category.category-updated.dlq belongs to Analytics' own consumer queue, not to this service's topology.
